evals.prompt: 为 internal/cli/ 写一个 scoped AGENTS.md（压缩 pipe-index 格式）。要求：只写该 scope 相关的 Where-to-look/Conventions/Anti-patterns，不要复制全仓库目录结构。
evals.expected_output: 在 internal/cli/ 下生成完整 AGENTS.md，内容以 |IMPORTANT 开头，含 |Scope:internal/cli，并覆盖命令树与服务组装相关的关键任务索引。
expectations: The output starts with a pipe-index AGENTS.md structure including a |IMPORTANT line.
The output contains scope-specific guidance for CLI command work.
The output does not dump a repo-wide top-level directory inventory unrelated to the CLI scope.

evals.prompt: 我最近在做 FreshRSS 命令开发（新增命令、配置读取、输出格式），请你先定位最合适的目录 scope，然后在那个目录下生成一份 scoped AGENTS.md（压缩格式）。如果有多个候选目录，先列出候选并让我选。
evals.expected_output: 先给出 2-6 个候选 scope root 目录并请求确认；确认后在选定 scope 下生成 AGENTS.md，包含命令入口、配置和输出边界的 where-to-look。
expectations: The run records candidate scope resolution before final output when the request is ambiguous.
The final chosen scope is justified and documented when the eval proceeds without an actual user reply.
The final AGENTS.md is in compressed pipe-index format.
The final AGENTS.md includes rss-cli-specific guidance rather than generic repository guidance.

evals.prompt: 把 internal/AGENTS.md 的内容改写为 pipe-index 压缩格式（保留信息，不要丢掉配置、错误输出、类型边界和 anti-pattern 要点），输出仍然写回 internal/AGENTS.md。
evals.expected_output: internal/AGENTS.md 被改写为以 | 开头的压缩格式，保留原文关键信息点且更易扫描。
expectations: The rewritten output is primarily pipe-index style instead of traditional markdown sections.
The rewritten output preserves configuration and output-boundary guidance from the source AGENTS.md.
The rewritten output preserves type-boundary and anti-pattern guidance from the source AGENTS.md.
The rewritten output is more compact than the source while retaining the requested facts.
